note: Sidewalk / pavement variant ground tiles, painted on a COPY of isoground/sidewalk.png. Same iso block format: 128x81 with a 2:1 diamond TOP face (apex (64,0), left (0,32), right (127,32), bottom (64,64)) plus extruded sides below. Detail is painted only on the top face using ground coords (u,v) in [0,1]^2 -> pixel (64+64u-64v, 32u+32v); the original block silhouette/alpha and side walls are preserved.
